# Production brief: Signal Lanterns

## Tempo map

Constant 124 bpm, 4/4, 72 bars (about 139 seconds). No tempo changes. Each Build ends with a one-beat silence before the Drop downbeat; the Outro's final root is held for four beats and faded over two seconds.

## Vocal treatment

None. The cue has no vocals; the lead synth takes the melodic role and is treated as the lead: mono centre, a 1/8-note ping-pong delay at 20 percent wet in the Drops only.

## Mix priorities

1. Kick and sub bass locked; sidechain the chord stab and pad to the kick with a fast release.
2. Lead synth clear between 1 and 3 kHz; notch the pad in the same band.
3. Keep the Breakdown piano dry and quiet (about minus 8 dB from the Drop level) so the second Build has room to rise.
4. Limit the master to minus 1 dB true peak; the second Drop should be the loudest passage by about 1.5 dB.

## Section notes

- Intro: pad plus plucked synth on the half-note motif fragments, high-pass sweeping down from 2 kHz.
- Build: closed hi-hat on eighths, bass on the root, snare roll over the final two bars, kick withheld.
- Drop: full kit, lead and bass in unison on the motif, chord stabs sidechained.
- Breakdown: piano alone on the inverted motif, bass returns at bar 5 under a slow filter.
- Second Build: white-noise riser from bar 1, snare roll from bar 5, kick withheld.
- Second Drop: add the second lead an octave up, open hi-hat on the off-beats.
- Outro: drop the kick and leads, pad and plucked synth only, close the filter, hold the root.
